decision.observation: At 1:40 p.m. Friday, the farmer is near the eastern end of the dirt road; the route onward is just beyond the right edge.
decision.hypothesis: Continuing east should reach the paved approach to Pelican Town, leaving time to find the southern beach route before Willy's shop closes.
decision.memory: Willy promised an item at the southeast beach; Fish Shop hours are 9:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. In town, seek a southern route instead of continuing straight to the eastern riverbank.
